## Example 2.2 · Finding the investment time {#fm2-example-2-2 .fm-slide }

Remy invests \$2500 at 8% p.a. simple interest for a period of time and receives \$50 interest. For how long (in months) did she invest the money?

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 5 · Example 2.2 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
$50=2500(0.08)N$, hence $N=50/200=0.25$ years, which is 3 months. Ask why 0.25 cannot be labelled months directly. Model rearrangement in OneNote.
:::
